purpose: One requirement of a password in PasswordStrength's checklist: a success check when met, an empty ring when not, and its label.

notFor.case: Any use outside a password checklist.
A list of items the person ticks off.

Met=false.visual: Empty ring with a Border/control edge; label Content/secondary.

a11y.role: none of its own; reads "met" / "not met" with its label
a11y.keyboard: Not focusable; no keyboard interaction of its own.

openQuestions: There is no failed or error look for an unmet rule after submit, only met / not met. Is one needed?
